title: +PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
description: Create a strong foundation for one's career through developing or enhancing one's professional brand, crafting effective career documents, and building strong business communication skills. Explore different career options and develop a plan to achieve one's career goals.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 300*, CORE 300*, ED 300*, ENGR 310*, LA 300* or SCI 300*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in BA 300, CORE 300, ED 300, ENGR 310, LA 300 and SCI 300.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
attribute_description: Core Education - Beyond OSU I, Career Preparation (CSC1)
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
meeting_html: TR 8am-9:50am in MLM 337 - Milam Hall 337 (9/23 to 12/4)
